requirements.requirement: Identify a specific article that was published between 2019 and 2021, both years inclusive, and was written by two authors.
The first author of that article participated in 2018 in a conference that took place in Aalborg.

The article mentions that, up to the time of publishing, the corresponding author was affiliated with a university, and that university in 2023 was among the 130 best universities in the world for 2024, according to the QS World University ranking.
The article discusses a phenomenon that involves images and has been addressed from a Systemic Functional Linguistics perspective.
The authors suggest that a different framework, which is mentioned in the first keyword of the article, may allow the identification of new elements related to the phenomenon.
Determine the second keyword in the mentioned article.
